name: bookverse
description: BOOKVERSE — The Living Library. Interactive 3D reading platform.

scripts.setup: npm run db:setup && npm run content:import
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @bookverse/server" "npm run dev -w @bookverse/web"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @bookverse/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run start -w @bookverse/server" "npm run preview -w @bookverse/web"
